payload.summary: Batch contains 6 items: 4 PDF invoices, 2 image scans, and 1 email with bank-change notice. Plan is to read each document, match to vendor master, PO and contract, verify VAT and payment history, independently verify decisions against source, draft payment batch and vendor emails, then STOP for human approval.

steps.title: Ingest and triage batch
steps.detail: Read PackWerk_RE_PW-2026-3381.pdf, RGC-1022.pdf, RGC-1047.pdf, Scan_2026-10-29.jpg, Wareneingang_RGC_13-10.jpg and email Neue Bankverbindung - Rechnung KH-24-0958.eml. Log file names, types, pages and sender/subject for 6 items.

steps.title: Extract invoice data
steps.detail: Extract vendor name, invoice number, date, net/gross amounts, VAT rate, PO reference and due date from the 4 PDF invoices and the 2 image scans. OCR Scan_2026-10-29.jpg and Wareneingang_RGC_13-10.jpg.

steps.title: Vendor master and PO matching
steps.detail: Investigate each extracted invoice against vendor master, open purchase orders and contracts. Confirm vendor ID, approved bank details and VAT treatment for PackWerk, RGC and Kaffeeimport Hansa.

steps.title: Three-way match and history check
steps.detail: Match invoices to goods receipt and PO. Check payment history for duplicates. Specifically review PackWerk_RE_PW-2026-3381, RGC-1022, RGC-1047 and KH-24-0958 from email for prior payments or re-sends.

steps.title: VAT and compliance review
steps.detail: Validate German VAT rules and reverse charge applicability per vendor and service type. Flag mismatched VAT IDs or rates.

steps.title: Watchlist extra scrutiny
steps.detail: Apply enhanced checks to items flagged in watchlist: bank change email, image quality, goods receipt vs invoice, unknown/forwarded cues.

steps.title: Independent verification
steps.detail: Have each decision independently verified against source document: amounts, dates, vendor name, bank IBAN and PO reference.

steps.title: Draft outputs
steps.detail: Draft payment batch lines for approvable invoices and draft vendor response emails in German where sender is German. Do not execute payment.

steps.title: Human approval gate
steps.detail: STOP for human approval. Present summary, watchlist findings and drafts. No payment or email is sent without explicit human sign-off.

args.subject: Request for corrected invoice RGC-1047 and goods receipt confirmation
args.body:
Dear Pieter de Vries,

Thank you for your invoice RGC-1047 dated in batch for €5,154.60 gross.

During our check we noted the following points that prevent processing:
- VAT is shown as 21% on the net amount of €4,260.00, resulting in VAT of €894.60. For this intra-EU B2B supply of 'Colombia Supremo 17/18 green coffee, 60 kg bags' we expect 0% VAT on the invoice with reverse charge / intra-Community acquisition by the buyer.
- We have no goods receipt evidence on file for invoice RGC-1047, therefore a three-way match cannot be completed.

Could you please provide a corrected invoice for the same quantity and net value with 0% VAT, and send us the delivery note / goods receipt confirmation for the 600 kg referenced on PO PO-2026-103.

Once we receive the corrected documents we will process payment promptly.

Kind regards,
Buchhaltung, Spree Roastery GmbH

args.subject: Bestätigung Ihrer Bankverbindung für Rechnung KH-24-0958
args.body:
Sehr geehrte Jana Petersen,

wir haben eine E-Mail mit dem Betreff 'Neue Bankverbindung - Rechnung KH-24-0958' erhalten, die eine Zahlung von €2.182,80 für Rechnung KH-24-0958 an das IBAN LT857044060012845733 veranlasst.

Nach unserer Prüfung entspricht dies nicht unseren Unterlagen. In unserem Vendor Master ist für Kaffeeimport Hansa GmbH das IBAN DE53880009184638342495 hinterlegt. Die Nachricht kam außerdem von der Domain kaffeimport-hansa.com und enthält den Hinweis, die Buchhaltung sei telefonisch nicht erreichbar.

Aus Sicherheitsgründen bitten wir Sie daher, uns Ihre aktuelle Bankverbindung ausschließlich über einen bekannten Kanal zu bestätigen und uns bitte telefonisch zu kontaktieren, um die Details für Rechnung KH-24-0958 zu klären.

Vielen Dank für Ihre Unterstützung.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Buchhaltung, Spree Roastery GmbH
